description: PostgreSQL 18 bigint overflow, integer arithmetic, promotion, and exact aggregate behavior
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_int8_arithmetic (id INT4 PRIMARY KEY, small_value INT2, regular_value INT4, big_value INT8);
SELECT SUM(small_value), AVG(small_value), SUM(regular_value), AVG(regular_value), SUM(big_value), AVG(big_value) FROM type_matrix_int8_arithmetic;
